data.raw_text:
Commuters who usually rely on passenger jeepneys resort to tricycles amid a transport strike that leaves several routes without jeepney operations in Nagtahan, Manila on Wednesday, April 15.

Transport groups Manibela and PISTON staged a nationwide strike from April 15 to 17 in protest of rising fuel prices and other sectoral concerns.

The disruption forced thousands of daily passengers to seek alternative modes of transport, resulting in longer travel times and higher fares.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB

data.raw_text:
ADVISORY

Please be informed that recent air quality monitoring in Manila indicates increased air pollution levels associated with the ongoing fire incident at the Navotas Sanitary Landfill. This pollution contains small particulate matter (PM2.5) that can enter the lungs and cause respiratory irritation, especially among vulnerable groups such as elderlies, children, infants, pregnant women, and individuals with pre-existing heart or lung conditions.

The public is advised to wear N95 or KN95 masks when outdoors. If unavailable, double surgical masks or a clean, damp cloth may be used as temporary alternatives. Limit outdoor activities and stay indoors whenever possible. Keep doors and windows closed and seal gaps with damp cloths.

Stay hydrated and ensure that medications for respiratory conditions are readily available. Seek immediate medical attention for any signs of breathing difficulty or related symptoms.

The University of the Philippines Manila strongly encourages all students, faculty, and employees to adhere to these precautions to reduce health risks associated with poor air quality.

Source: Department of Health and Manila Public Information Office

data.raw_text:
Naka-activate na ang MMDA Emergency Operations Center (EOC) sa unang araw ng tigil-pasada na isinasagawa ng ilang transport groups sa pangunguna ng Manibela at Piston.

Nai-report sa EOC ang ilang rally ng mga grupo sa Quezon City, Pasay City, Paranaque City ngayong umaga para iprotesta ang nararanasang krisis ng transport sector sa gitna ng patuloy na pagtaas ng presyo ng langis. Wala pang stranded na pasahero ang nai-report.

Pinangunahan ni MMDA Deputy Chairman Usec. Frisco San Juan Jr. ang pagmo-monitor ng sitwasyon sa EDSA at iba pang pangunahing lansangan, sa direktiba ni MMDA Chairman Atty. Don Artes.

Naka-preposition at standby naman ang mga behikulo na magsasakay ng mga pasahero na maaaring maaapektuhan ng transport strike. Idedeploy lamang ang mga sasakyan kung kinakailangan.
 #mmda #mmdaatyourservice
